about: Stories come from the shared bank: games/shared/stories.json (50+ per level, shuffled every game). This file has the How to play slides and bonus cards.

intro.title: Story Order
text: The five sentences of a story are mixed up.
Put them in the right order!

intro.title: Write the letters
text: Read every sentence with your team.
Write the order on your board, like B C A.

intro.title: Win points
text: Look for time words: first, then, after that, finally.

before.name: New title
before.text: Write a new title for the story: +1

before.name: Silent team
before.text: No talking! Point and write only: +2

before.name: What next?
before.text: Write a sixth sentence for the story: +2

secret.name: Fastest team
secret.text: +2 for the first team with the right order!

secret.name: Read it aloud
secret.text: +1 if your team reads the story in order!
